Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create one finished complete logo on a transparent square canvas by editing image 1.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the full logo edit target and the authoritative style/composition. Image 2 is ONLY a shape reference for the replacement RIGHT column.
PROTECTED: Keep the entire blue left outer bracket and central tall solid capsule from image 1 exactly in their current locations, sizes, outlines, rounded corners and colors. Retain the distinctive rounded projecting left toe on the bottom bracket. Keep the same complete-logo framing and square canvas. Do not redesign, re-center or rescale the protected shapes.
EDIT ONLY THE RIGHT COLUMN: Remove the current connected shape with two hollow holes. In precisely that right column footprint, use the solid two-piece split-capsule i structure of image 2: a short sky-blue domed upper cap and a long blue lower body, separated by one clear transparent slit. The two parts are equally wide with aligned vertical sidewalls, sharing a single axis. Their collective outer silhouette follows ONE broad vertical capsule. Match the original right column's substantial width, approximately nine tenths the central capsule width, and align its top and bottom to the central capsule. Do not shrink the reference into a skinny i. The upper cap occupies roughly 28 percent of total height, the slit about 5 percent, and the lower body the remainder, optically adjusted. The upper outer dome and lower outer bowl should harmonize with the center capsule. Keep all surrounding gaps optically balanced with the existing logo.
STYLE: Preserve image 1's simple clean flat logo style, original medium blue and sky-blue colors. Image 2's glow is NOT part of the desired design: use only its silhouette geometry. Crisp smooth anti-aliased edges. Real transparency outside the shapes and inside the slit. No halos, glow, shadows, lighting, neon effects, outlines, textures, black rectangle, labels, typography, comparison panel, extra shapes or holes. Output the COMPLETE full logo, not an isolated i.
VERSION A — STRAIGHT CUT: The sky-blue cap's bottom edge and the long blue body's top edge are straight horizontal parallel lines. Use only small smooth corner fillets where these cut edges meet the vertical sides. The horizontal transparent slit must look even, quiet and deliberate. The top dome and bottom bowl are large rounded ends; the facing cut edges are substantially straight, NOT two opposing pill ends. Transfer the structure of image 2, without its glow.
